question: Central idea of poem lines from the deserted village?
text: The central idea of Oliver Goldsmith’s *The Deserted Village* is that **a society does not truly prosper when a few grow wealthy at the expense of ordinary people**. Goldsmith contrasts Auburn’s once lively village life with its later emptiness, mourning the loss of a community whose residents were forced to leave when a wealthy landowner took control of the land. ([poetryfoundation.org](https://www.poetryfoundation.org/poems/44292/the-deserted-village?utm_source=openai))
